review_note: Pinned sdga proposition 2532 supplies triangulated structure and distinguished triangles via admissible short exact sequences, referring to the previously constructed shifts and admissibility convention. Stage A adds explicit shift signs and a graded-splitting definition, neither of which is exposed in a safe formal statement in the local source, and its structured hypotheses already include 'the category is triangulated'. The enriched formulation requires separate review.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{proposition-homotopy-category-triangulated}
Let $(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{O})$ be a ringed site.
Let $\mathcal{A}$ be a sheaf of differential graded algebras
on $(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{O})$.
The homotopy category $K(\textit{Mod}(\mathcal{A}, \text{d}))$
is a triangulated category where
\begin{enumerate}
\item the shift functors are those constructed in
Section \ref{section-shift-dg},
\item the distinguished triangles are those triangles
in $K(\textit{Mod}(\mathcal{A}, \text{d}))$ which are
isomorphic as a triangle to a triangle
$$
\mathcal{K} \to \mathcal{L} \to \mathcal{N}
\xrightarrow{\delta} \mathcal{K}[1],\quad\quad
\delta = \pi \circ \text{d}_\mathcal{L} \circ s
$$
constructed from an admissible short exact sequence
$0 \to \mathcal{K} \to \mathcal{L} \to \mathcal{N} \to 0$
in $\textit{Mod}(\mathcal{A}, \text{d})$ above.
\end{enumerate}

review_note: Pinned sdga lemma 2589 says the category of sheaf DG modules over a DG O-algebra is Grothendieck abelian, with no boundedness, finiteness or site restrictions beyond a ringed site. Stage A reproduces the assertion.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-dgm-grothendieck-abelian}
Let $(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{O})$ be a ringed site.
Let $(\mathcal{A}, \text{d})$ be a differential graded $\mathcal{O}$-algebra.
The category $\textit{Mod}(\mathcal{A}, \text{d})$
is a Grothendieck abelian category.
